```{r}
library(RUVprps)       
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(biomaRt)       
```

```{r}
mouse  <- useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset="mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

anno   <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "gene_biotype"),
  filters    = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values     = rownames(raw_counts),
  mart       = mouse
)

anno   <- anno[!duplicated(anno$ensembl_gene_id), ]
rownames(anno) <- anno$ensembl_gene_id
```

```{r}
min.count   <- 15
min.samples <- ceiling(0.1 * nsamp)
keep.expr   <- rowSums(raw_counts > min.count) >= min.samples
```

```{r}
keep.pc     <- anno$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"
```

```{r}
keep.entrez <- !is.na(anno$entrezgene_id)
keep.symbol <- !is.na(anno$mgi_symbol) & anno$mgi_symbol != ""
```

```{r}
keep.genes  <- names(keep.expr)[keep.expr] 
keep.genes  <- intersect(keep.genes, rownames(anno)[keep.pc & keep.entrez & keep.symbol])
```

```{r}
# subset count matrix
counts.keep <- raw_counts[keep.genes, ]
```


```{r}
log2_filtered_tmm <- read.table("log2_filtered_tmm.txt", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
# filter out zero-variance rows:
log2_filtered_tmm <- log2_filtered_tmm[
  apply(log2_filtered_tmm, 1, var) != 0, 
  , 
  drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r}

est_raw <- read.delim(
  "estimate_scores.txt",
  sep    = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip   = 2,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(est_raw) <- est_raw[[1]]
est_df <- as.data.frame(est_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE])
if (!"ESTIMATEScore" %in% rownames(est_df)) {
  stop("Row 'ESTIMATEScore' not found in estimate_scores.txt. Check the file.")
}

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(log2_filtered_tmm), colnames(est_df))
purity_vector <- setNames(
  rep(NA_real_, ncol(log2_filtered_tmm)),
  colnames(log2_filtered_tmm)
)
purity_vector[common_samples] <- as.numeric(est_df["ESTIMATEScore", common_samples])
if (length(setdiff(colnames(log2_filtered_tmm), common_samples)) > 0) {
  warning("ESTIMATEScore missing for some samples: ", 
          paste(setdiff(colnames(log2_filtered_tmm), common_samples), collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r}
# Build a SummarizedExperiment named se with counts + purity
coldata <- DataFrame(
  sampleID = colnames(log2_filtered_tmm),
  purity   = purity_vector,
  row.names = colnames(log2_filtered_tmm),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = as.matrix(log2_filtered_tmm)),
  colData = coldata
)
```

```{r}
if (!exists("housekeeping_mouse_ids")) {
  stop("'housekeeping_mouse_ids' must be defined as a character vector of Ensembl IDs")
}

# Suppose 'se' is your SummarizedExperiment and 'housekeeping_mouse_ids' is defined:
ncg.log <- rownames(se) %in% housekeeping_mouse_ids

# Check how many were found:
table(ncg.log)
# should show how many TRUE vs FALSE

# Now call addNCGs with that logical vector:
se <- addNCGs(
  se.obj     = se,
  ncg        = ncg.log,
  subset.name = "housekeeping"
)

```

```{r}
se <- createPrPsForContinuousUV(
  se.obj             = se,
  assay.name         = "counts",
  bio.variables      = "treatment",
  main.uv.variable   = "purity",
  other.uv.variables = NULL,
  min.sample.for.ps  = 3,
  bio.clustering.method       = "quantile",
  nb.bio.clusters             = 2,
  other.uv.clustering.method  = "kmeans",
  nb.other.uv.clusters        = 2,
  apply.log                   = TRUE,
  pseudo.count                = 1,
  check.se.obj                = TRUE,
  remove.na                   = "both",
  plot.prps.map               = TRUE,
  prps.group.name             = "purity",
  prps.sets.name              = NULL,
  save.se.obj                 = TRUE,
  verbose                     = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
se@metadata$PRPS <- NULL


counts_mat <- assay(se, "counts")
purity_vec  <- colData(se)$purity
trt_vec     <- colData(se)$treatment


prps_list <- list()
for (trt in unique(trt_vec)) {
  idx <- which(trt_vec == trt & !is.na(purity_vec))
  if (length(idx) < 6) next

  ord      <- idx[order(purity_vec[idx], decreasing = TRUE)]
  top3_idx <- ord[1:3]
  bot3_idx <- ord[(length(ord) - 2):length(ord)]

  high_ps  <- rowMeans(counts_mat[, top3_idx, drop = FALSE])
  low_ps   <- rowMeans(counts_mat[, bot3_idx, drop = FALSE])

  prp_mat  <- cbind(high_ps, low_ps)
  colnames(prp_mat) <- c(trt, trt)   # **both columns get the same name**
  rownames(prp_mat) <- rownames(counts_mat)

  prps_list[[trt]] <- prp_mat
}

# (Optional diagnostic)
message("PRPS list length: ", length(prps_list))
if (length(prps_list) > 0) {
  message("Arms with PRPS sets: ", paste(names(prps_list), collapse = ", "))
}


se@metadata$PRPS <- list(
  supervised = list(
    purity = list(prps.data = prps_list)
  )
)


for (nm in names(prps_list)) {
  cols <- colnames(prps_list[[nm]])
  if (length(unique(cols)) != 1) {
    stop("PRPS columns for ", nm, " are not identical.")
  }
}
message("Each PRPS matrix now has two columns with the same name, e.g. '", 
        names(prps_list)[1], "'")
```

```{r}
ncg.log <- rownames(se) %in% housekeeping_mouse_ids


se@metadata$NCG <- list(
  supervised = list(
    housekeeping = list(
      ncg.set = list(
        housekeeping = ncg.log
      )
    )
  )
)



res_se <- RUVIIIprps(
  se.obj             = se,
  assay.name         = "counts",
  control.assay.type = "prps",
  prps.type          = "supervised",
  prps.group         = "purity",
  prps.set.names     = NULL,
  ncg.type           = "supervised",       
  ncg.group          = "housekeeping",
  ncg.set.names      = NULL,
  technical.replicates = NULL,
  k                  = 2,
  apply.log          = TRUE,
  data.to.log        = "assay",
  pseudo.count       = 1,
  eta                = NULL,
  include.intercept  = TRUE,
  return.info        = FALSE,
  check.se.obj       = TRUE,
  remove.na          = "none",
  output.name        = NULL,
  save.se.obj        = TRUE,
  verbose            = TRUE
)
```
